findings.finding: DeclaredLanguageBinding accepts candidate/partial only. CapabilityMatrix.summary hardcodes qualified_entries=0; build_capability_matrix accepts only catalog/voices/bindings and has no qualification evidence argument. to_dict is export-only. The native controller always rebuilds with bindings=() and has no durable import/review/store actions.

No separate durable per-language capability qualification intake/review path was found in all 399 current product modules. Other canonical-tag consumers and declaration/inference markers do not feed accepted qualification evidence into the matrix.

Finalization section 1 and V3-15 require evidence-based distinctions and exact app/engine/pack/test/reviewer provenance; the existing permanently empty verified path is missing software glue for recording legitimate completed qualifications. The specification does not demand a separate generic review framework.

A software path does not prove any of the 135 languages acoustically or accessibly qualified. Real exact-engine/model assets, test outputs and independent linguistic/accessibility review remain separate pending evidence; current zero qualified languages is truthful.
